final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT link_to_event, AVG(spent) AS avg_spent, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) AS mean_event_avg_remaining FROM event_averages) SELECT e.link_to_event, e.avg_spent, e.avg_remaining, e.avg_remaining - o.mean_event_avg_remaining AS remaining_difference FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY remaining_difference IS NULL, remaining_difference DESC LIMIT 10
